cohort: 176 women with secondary infertility undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment; 44 women with a history of GTD and 132 women without a history of GTD
finding: Women with a history of GTD had a significantly reduced live birth rate after IVF/ICSI cycles compared to women without a history of GTD.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in the mode of delivery for women with a history of GTD who underwent IVF/ICSI compared to those without a GTD history.
